description: Source code for FreeType support for .Z compressed files, implementing LZW decompression and stream handling.

methods.name: ft_lzw_check_header
methods.description: Checks and skips the .Z header in the stream.

methods.name: ft_lzw_file_init
methods.description: Initializes an FT_LZWFile structure for decompression.

methods.name: ft_lzw_file_done
methods.description: Cleans up and finalizes an FT_LZWFile structure.

methods.name: ft_lzw_file_fill_output
methods.description: Fills the output buffer with decompressed data.

methods.name: ft_lzw_file_skip_output
methods.description: Skips a specified number of decompressed bytes.

methods.name: ft_lzw_file_io
methods.description: Performs I/O operations on the decompressed data stream.

methods.name: ft_lzw_stream_close
methods.description: Closes the LZW stream and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ft_lzw_stream_io
methods.description: Reads data from the LZW stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_OpenLZW
methods.description: Public function to open a stream with LZW decompression support.
